_comment: Copy this to ~/.patroam/secrets.json and fill in your keys. PATROAM loads them at startup (they never live in tracked source). Real env vars take precedence. NEVER commit your real secrets.json. Everything here is optional — PATROAM runs without any of it, each feature just stays off.
META_ACCESS_TOKEN: EAAB... (Meta token with ads_read — a System User token doesn't expire)
_clickup: Task tracking. Token: ClickUp -> Settings -> Apps.
CLICKUP_SPACE_ID: 90189951700 (the Space you want PATROAM to manage)
_slack: Phone access + private dev-logs. See patroam/slack_bot.py for setup.
_gcal: Google Calendar — run: python -m patroam.wire_gcal (it fills these in for you, and can reuse the YouTube OAuth client below)
_youtube: Content pipeline uploads — run: python -m patroam.wire_youtube
